description: This file is a Java test class for HibernateLocationDAO, testing methods related to retrieving location entities with specific tags within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: HibernateLocationDAOTest
classes.description: Test class extending BaseContextSensitiveTest to test 'HibernateLocationDAO' methods related to location tags.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test runs by executing a predefined dataset.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAllTags_shouldGetLocationsHavingAllTags
methods.description: Tests that the DAO correctly retrieves locations that have all specified tags.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAllTags_shouldReturnEmptyListWhenNoLocationHasTheGivenTags
methods.description: Verifies that the method returns an empty list when no location matches the tags.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAllTags_shouldIgnoreNullValuesInLocationTagList
methods.description: Ensures that null entries in the list of tags do not affect the retrieval logic.
